description: This skill should be used when the user needs a standardized job description written from role basics. Trigger phrases include '写个 JD', '岗位 JD', '招聘启事', '岗位职责和任职要求', '招聘信息怎么写', 'job description'. It outputs a complete JD with responsibilities, requirements, bonus points, reporting line, and compliance-safe wording.
